The house

A whole bush manor, entirely your own.

Set among giant shade trees on a private Zambian estate, the Thorn Tree Manor House sleeps up to ten across five characterful bedrooms. There’s a full self-catering kitchen, a generous lounge with a fireplace, a shaded boma for long dinners, and a large pool looking straight into the bush — where elephant, giraffe and antelope drift by. Intimate, secure and effortlessly relaxed, with Victoria Falls within reach.

5 bedrooms · sleeps 10Full kitchenPrivate poolBoma & fireplace
